candidates.source_title: What an Oil Rig Camera REALLY Filmed in the Gulf 🐟
candidates.source_description:
An oil rig camera in the Gulf of Mexico may have filmed a world-record tuna.

A remotely operated vehicle was inspecting the drilling riser of a deepwater rig off the American Gulf coast when this fish came out of the dark and swam the length of the pipe. The 18-foot figure on screen assumes that white riser is 4 feet across; people who put the riser nearer 3 feet get about 10 to 11 feet of fish, and Outdoor Life's eyeball estimate lands at 14 to 16.
